summary: 墨西哥城奥运会使人们关注高海拔环境对耐力表现的影响，高原训练与模拟低氧帐篷此后得到采用。作者将获准使用的帐篷与遭禁的高科技泳衣并列，追问体育组织应依据什么来认定不公平优势。
logic: 高原比赛引发生理疑问
追问技术公平的判断标准

paragraphs.brief: 克拉克在高原奥运会倒下
sentences: What happened to the Australian athlete Ron Clarke in the 10,000 metres at the Mexico City Olympics of 1968 is now virtually forgotten, though at the time it was headline news.
1968 年墨西哥城奥运会男子一万米比赛中，澳大利亚选手罗恩·克拉克的遭遇曾是头条新闻，如今却几乎被人遗忘。
Clarke was the greatest distance runner in history; he’d broken more world records than anybody else.
克拉克是当时史上最杰出的长跑选手，打破世界纪录的次数无人能及。
But in front of 55,000 horrified spectators, the event went disastrously wrong.
然而在 5.5 万名惊愕的观众面前，比赛出现了灾难性的意外。
In the third lap, one runner keeled over and, with six laps to go, two more were carried away.
一名选手第三圈时倒下，离终点还有六圈时，又有两人被抬出赛场。
Yet the race was being conducted at a relatively leisurely speed: the halfway time was the slowest since the Paris Olympics of 1924.
其实比赛节奏相对缓慢，半程用时是自 1924 年巴黎奥运会以来最慢的。
With two laps to go, Clarke was in the leading pack.
还剩两圈时，克拉克仍在领跑集团中。
‘I’d never felt better in a race,’ he says.
他说：“我在比赛中从来没有感觉这么好过。”
But suddenly he too began to struggle, and as the frontrunners moved up a gear, a gap opened up.
但他忽然也感到吃力，前面的选手一提速，差距就拉开了。
Clarke remembers nothing of his last lap, which he ran in 90 seconds.
克拉克不记得自己是怎么跑完最后一圈的，那一圈他用了九十秒。
‘Normally I would run it in 64,’ he explains.
他解释说：“平时我只要六十四秒。”
He stumbled across the line in sixth place and collapsed.
他踉跄着以第六名冲线，随即倒下。
He was administered oxygen and stretchered off the track.
人们给他吸氧，用担架把他抬离跑道。
paragraphs.gist: 1968 年墨西哥城奥运万米赛上，多名选手先后倒下，屡破纪录的克拉克在前段配速并不快的情况下仍于最后阶段崩溃，以第六名完赛。

paragraphs.brief: 高海拔影响与赛前担忧
sentences: Mexico City is surrounded by mountains and is over 2,240 metres above sea level.
墨西哥城四周群山环绕，海拔超过 2240 米。
That the altitude would have an impact on the Games was predicted.
据预测，海拔会影响奥运会。
Clarke had raised the issue himself, but had been told by the Australian sports authorities that complaining was regarded as bad sportsmanship.
克拉克本人曾提出这一问题，但澳大利亚体育官员告诉他，抱怨这件事会被视为缺乏体育精神。
As it turned out, he had good reason to do so.
事实证明，他有很好的理由这样做。
Clearly, the link between athletic performance and altitude needed further investigation.
显然，运动性能和高度之间的联系需要进一步调查。
paragraphs.gist: 墨西哥城海拔超过 2240 米，克拉克赛前担忧高海拔的影响却被视为有失体育精神，而比赛结果说明这一因素值得研究。

sentences: Although there were few standout performances in distance running at the Mexico Games, they marked a turning point: the start of an astonishing record of success by East Africans.
墨西哥城奥运会上的突出长跑成绩不多，却成了转折点，东非选手此后开始取得令人惊叹的一连串胜利。
While Clarke lay crumpled in a heap, runners from Kenya and Ethiopia were celebrating their gold and silver medals.
克拉克蜷缩跌倒在地时，肯尼亚和埃塞俄比亚的选手正在庆祝夺得金牌和银牌。
The record books confirm how entrenched this pattern has become.
记录书证实了这种模式已变得多么根深蒂固。
The names of the seven fastest men in history over 5,000 metres are Bekele, Gebrselassie, Komen, Kipchoge, Sihine, Songkok and Chereno.
历史上超过5000米的七名最快的人的名字是Bekele，Gebrselassie，Komen，Kipchoge，Sihine，Songkok和Chereno.
They are all from either Kenya or Ethiopia.
他们都来自肯尼亚或埃塞俄比亚。
Between 1997 and 2011 the 10,000 metres world record was smashed five times, dropping from 26:31.32 to 26:17.53.
在1997年至2011年期间，世界纪录的1万米被打破5次，从26:31.32降至26:17.53。
Each time, the record was broken by a Kenyan or an Ethiopian.
每次，记录都被一名肯尼亚人或一名埃塞俄比亚人打破。

While there is a complex mix of economic, political, social and cultural explanations for the pre-eminence of East Africans, one factor is surely that many of these athletes have lived most of their lives in thin air.
东非选手的优势有复杂的经济、政治、社会和文化原因，但其中一个因素无疑是许多人毕生大部分时间生活在空气稀薄的高海拔地区。
paragraphs.gist: 墨西哥城奥运揭开东非长跑选手长期称雄的序幕，作者认为除经济、社会和文化原因外，许多运动员长期生活在高海拔也是因素之一。

paragraphs.brief: 高住低练的益处和困难
sentences: At high altitudes, a number of physiological alterations occur, most importantly, more red blood cells and haemoglobin are produced.
高海拔会引起多种生理变化，最重要的是身体产生更多红细胞和血红蛋白。
This, in turn, increases the capacity of the blood to carry oxygen, which feeds the muscles and which gives an advantage to the athletes when they return to sea level.
这会提高血液向肌肉输送氧气的能力，使运动员回到海平面高度后获得优势。
However, it is impossible to train with the same level of intensity in the mountains—aerobic capacity and cardio-respiratory function both suffer at altitude.
但山区的有氧能力和心肺功能都会受到影响，无法保持与低海拔时相同的训练强度。
As a result, the consensus is that the optimum approach to athletic preparation is: Live High, Train Low (LHTL).
因此普遍认可的最佳备赛做法是“高住低练”，即在高海拔居住、到低海拔训练。
Yet that has obvious practical drawbacks.
然而，这显然有实际的缺点。
Not many people live in the mountains and those who do would prefer not to spend several hours each day driving up and down winding treacherous roads.
住在山区的人并不多，即便住在那里，也不会愿意每天花数小时驾车在蜿蜒险峻的山路上下往返。
paragraphs.gist: 高海拔生活能提高血液携氧能力，却不利于保持高强度训练，所以运动员理想上可住在高处、在低处训练，但日常往返并不容易。

paragraphs.brief: 合法低氧帐篷模拟高原
sentences: That’s where the altitude tent—sometimes called the hypoxic tent—comes in.
这时，高原模拟帐篷，也叫低氧帐篷，就能派上用场。
Around two decades ago, two different scientists had the same exciting thought.
大约20年前，两位不同的科学家有着同样的令人兴奋的想法。

If they could artificially control the atmosphere within a confined space, they could simulate the effects of high altitude and save an athlete at sea-level from the time and expense of travelling to higher ground.
如果能人为控制密闭空间里的空气，就能模拟高海拔的效果，让海平面附近的运动员免去前往高处的时间和花费。
Altitude tents have improved over the years: they’re not as hot or as noisy as the early prototypes, and are much cheaper too.
高空帐篷多年来有所改善：它们不像早期的原型那样热或吵闹，而且价格也低得多。
They are also perfectly lawful.
它们也是完全合法的。
Five years ago, when the tents were investigated by WADA (the World Anti-Doping Agency), it was ruled that they did not violate the spirit of distance running.
五年前，世界反兴奋剂机构研究了这种帐篷，裁定其并不违背长跑运动的精神。
It is now routine for athletes to sleep in them in preparation for an event.
现在，运动员在其中过夜备赛已经很常见。
paragraphs.gist: 低氧帐篷通过调节空气模拟高海拔，既可免去往返山地的成本，又已获世界反兴奋剂机构认可，因而成为常见备赛工具。

paragraphs.brief: 高科技泳衣从许可到禁用
sentences: However, it is not the case that all new technologies gain approval.
然而，并非所有新技术都得到批准。
In 2008, a staggering 105 world records were broken in swimming, the vast majority achieved by competitors wearing the new Speedo LZR Racer suit.
2008 年游泳项目一共打破了惊人的 105 项世界纪录，其中绝大部分由身穿新款 Speedo LZR Racer 泳衣的选手创造。
These suits use a high-tech fabric tested in Nasa’s wind tunnels, which reduces drag and improves buoyancy.
这种泳衣的高科技面料经过美国国家航空航天局的风洞测试，可以减少阻力并提高浮力。
The LZR was initially sanctioned by FINA, the international swimming body.
LZR 最初得到国际泳联批准。
But as better suits were produced by Speedo and other manufacturers, and more records were broken, they became increasingly controversial.
但随着 Speedo 和其他厂商做出性能更好的泳衣、更多纪录被打破，它们也越来越有争议。
In a 2009 ruling, FINA changed its mind, banning all suits made with this high-tech fabric.
2009 年，国际泳联改变立场，禁止使用所有由这种高科技面料制成的泳衣。
paragraphs.gist: 与低氧帐篷不同，能减阻增浮力的高科技泳衣在大量纪录被打破后引起争议，国际泳联最终推翻原决定，禁止使用这类面料。

paragraphs.brief: 新技术裁决应有一致依据
sentences: Going faster, higher, stronger is integral to the logic of athletics in general, and the Olympics in particular.
跑得更快、更高、更强是整个运动、特别是奥运会逻辑的组成部分。
Athletes believe they need records all the time.
运动员认为自己必须不断刷新纪录。
And the only way is through minute changes of 0.0001 of a second.
为此有时只能争取万分之一秒这样的微小进步。
But when a new technology is invented, the relevant sports authority has to consider whether to embrace or reject it.
但当发明新技术时，有关体育当局必须考虑是接受还是拒绝新技术。
In some cases, athletes are granted permission to use the technology: in others, it is banned.
在某些情况下，运动员获准使用这种技术：在另一些情况下，则被禁止使用这种技术。
But whatever the outcome, rulings should not appear arbitrary: arguments have to be examined and weighed and the rules of logic ought to apply in every case.
但是，无论结果如何，裁决都不应显得武断：必须审查和权衡各种论点，逻辑规则应适用于每一案件。
paragraphs.gist: 突破纪录固然是竞技体育的动力，但技术该获准还是禁止，需要管理机构在每个具体案例中论证取舍，使裁决有一致的依据。

克拉克在墨西哥城奥运会意外失利，使他赛前提出的高海拔顾虑有了具体例证。
从长跑成绩看身体适应

correct: The worries Clarke had before the Mexico Games were not taken into account.
克拉克在墨西哥运动会前的担忧没有得到考虑
At one stage of the Mexico Games 10,000 metres, Clarke was near the front.

items.en: For distance running, WADA concluded that the altitude tent was not contrary to the ________ of the sport.
items.zh: 对于长跑，世界反兴奋剂机构认定，使用高海拔模拟帐篷并不违背这项运动的________。

items.en: This is made possible by better ________ and training, as well as improved clothing and equipment.
items.zh: 更先进的________、更好的训练，以及服装和装备的改进，使这成为可能。
items.why: 本空要求来自文章的词，且和“and training” 搭配: 最贴合、且在文中反复出现的就是 technology。题干后面又举“clothing and equipment”作技术载体的例子。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

clauses: What happened to the Australian athlete Ron Clarke in the 10,000 metres at the Mexico City Olympics of 1968 is now virtually forgotten, ….

先读主句的动作，再用 though 把这一层关系补进去。

lead: Olympic athletes increasingly depend on technology to help them win - but is that fair?
奥林匹克运动员越来越依赖技术帮助他们获胜，但公平吗？
